questions.title: What behaviour is wanted for external links?
questions.question: What should the rendered HTML or library behaviour be so that readers do not lose their place?
questions.options: (a) add `target="_blank"` to external links (b) add `target="_blank"` plus `rel="noopener noreferrer"` (c) add only a `rel` or CSS class so a site can style or script it (d) Other

questions.title: What counts as an external link?
questions.question: Which link targets are external?
questions.options: (a) any absolute URL with a host (`http://`, `https://`) (b) absolute URLs whose host differs from a configured site host (c) any URL with a scheme, including `mailto:` (d) Other

questions.title: Opt-in or default?
questions.question: Should the behaviour be off by default, enabled through an extension or option, or applied to every conversion?
questions.options: (a) opt-in extension or option, default output unchanged (b) on by default (c) Other

questions.title: Which link forms are covered?
questions.question: Should the behaviour apply to inline links, reference links, autolinks (`<https://example.com>`) and raw HTML `<a>` tags?
questions.options: (a) inline and reference links only (b) also autolinks (c) also raw HTML (d) Other

questions.title: Which attributes are added?
questions.question: If attributes are added, should the user be able to configure them, and is `rel="noopener noreferrer"` required alongside `target`?
